title: Batch native commit operation path resolution
goal: Remove six Git process launches per commit without caching paths or weakening operation guards.
checkpoint: All 142 local-workflow tests passed in 163.36s with four threads; independent review and Clippy/fmt passed. Ready for integrated native gate, no publication yet.
measurements: Ten-agent same coverage: baseline 38.19s, changed 37.53s, one sample each and noisy; no reliable end-to-end speed ratio claimed.
Five primitive pairs: separate ms 369.09, 451.35, 472.19, 299.84, 343.00 vs batch ms 48.56, 58.57, 42.22, 40.25, 50.84; six fewer process launches per commit.
Two new guard/path regressions passed in 6.94s; Clippy -D warnings passed. No cache or skipped guards.
Full changed binary: 142 passed, 0 failed, 163.36s at 4 threads, ordinary local environment; not directly comparable to prior 345.42s isolated gate environment and competing binaries.
